the environmental conditions during the processing and ripening of Iberian hams have an influence on the proteolysis of this product.
the processing conditions of the Iberian ham, mainly the temperature and salt content, influence the proteolysis during its maturation.

the environmental conditions during the ripening process have a strong influence on the formation of non-protein compounds during the ripening of Iberian hams.
